answer: Cluster identities by correlated mistakes: each epoch hides a few trap items and records which wrong answers each agent gives. Independent agents wander off in different directions; a farm running one model errs in lockstep, like rings cut from the same timber. Agents whose errors match beyond chance share one reward pool, so a hundred names earn what one does. Evading this means paying for truly diverse models and prompts per identity, which costs more than the vault of rewards a sybil could drain.
